themes.description: Reviews related to account security, data protection, and the safety of funds.
Suggestions or feedback regarding specific trading functionalities, tools, and user interface for placing orders or viewing charts.
Feedback on the ease of use, navigation, and overall user experience within the application.
Concerns about the overall trustworthiness, security, or general reliability of the platform and its services.
Feedback regarding the presence or absence of specific features, investment options, or functionalities within the platform.
This theme covers general feedback about the overall user experience, ease of use, and satisfaction with the platform's design and functionality.
This theme covers issues related to downloading, installing, logging in, or gaining initial access to the application.
This theme covers concerns related to data privacy, security breaches, fraudulent activities, manipulative practices, and overall trustworthiness of the platform.
Issues related to IPO application, allotment, and participation.
Reviews expressing satisfaction, good experience, or positive sentiment without specific issues.
Issues related to application design, navigation, user experience, and missing or desired features.
Covers overall positive or negative sentiment about the application that doesn't fit specific predefined themes, including general satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
Concerns or suggestions related to language options, localization, and multilingual support within the application.
Covers general feedback on the app's usability, interface, and overall user satisfaction.
Issues related to the activation or setup of a user's account.
Issues related to account opening, verification, modification, or closure processes.
Issues related to the app's core functions, installation, or interaction with other device features.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or requests for additional tools within the platform.
Issues related to missing or malfunctioning trading features, and general account functionality like adding funds or account setup.
Reviews commenting on the positive performance or usefulness of specific application features or overall platform capabilities.
Reviews related to the design, layout, usability, and overall user experience of the application's interface.
This theme covers feedback related to new feature requests, existing feature improvements, and user interface/experience design suggestions.
This theme covers feedback regarding the absence of desired features or services within the platform.
Concerns related to the frequency, necessity, or issues with application updates.
Covers overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction with the app's general functionality, design, or usefulness without specific issues.
Concerns related to app trustworthiness, security vulnerabilities, data privacy, or alleged fraudulent activities.

This theme covers issues related to the availability, accuracy, or clarity of financial reports, statements, and analytical tools within the platform. It includes missing profit/loss statements, tax deduction details, or brokerage calculations.
This theme covers user suggestions for new features, improvements to existing functionalities, or changes in product design. It includes requests for specific options or tools.
This theme addresses user feedback regarding changes in the application's features, design, or functionality, particularly when useful elements are removed or altered negatively after an update.
